subject: Giant Octorok
text: The Giant Octorok is stunned when hit with the Boomerang, exposing the weak green spot on its back to sword slashes.

evidence.quote: The weapon of choice for this battle is of course going to be the Boomerang so make sure it is equipped... When you hit the miniboss with your Boomerang, he is stunned for a moment but his only weakspot it on the back so you have to run around the circle and try to get his back before he starts up again.

subject: Giant Octorok
text: Getting hit by the Giant Octorok deals half a heart of damage, while the middle spikes deal a quarter heart of damage.

evidence.quote: If he hits you, you're going to lose half a heart piece and if the spikes along the middle thing hit you, you're going to lose a quarter heart piece.

subject: Giant Octorok
text: The Giant Octorok takes about three hits to defeat.

subject: Pots
text: All of the pots around Barinade's room contain Recovery Hearts.

evidence.quote: all of the pots around the room each contain a Recovery Heart which should be enough to get you back to full from being almost dead.

subject: Barinade
text: Barinade is vulnerable to the Boomerang, which must be used to sever its three ceiling tentacles before stunning its body and attacking with the sword.

evidence.quote: Use the L/Z button to lock onto the three things that attach the boss to the ceiling and hit all three of them individually with the Boomerang... Aim for the main body part and throw your Boomerang to stun it, if it turns blue then you know it's stunned. Slash it as much as possible with your sword until you can't hurt it anymore.

subject: Phantom Ganon
text: During his first phase, the real Phantom Ganon emerges from a painting through a purple portal and can be struck by firing the Fairy Bow into the portal before he attacks.

evidence.quote: The other will jump out of the painting through a purple portal and shoot a huge electricity blast at the ground which goes in all directions... You should have been aiming your Fairy Bow the whole time, when the portal appears fire into the middle of the portal and Phantom Ganon will be hit, turning around and not attacking.

subject: Phantom Ganon
text: Phantom Ganon transitions to his second phase after taking three hits.

evidence.quote: After three hits the second phase starts.

subject: Phantom Ganon
text: In his second phase, Phantom Ganon's energy blasts can be deflected back at him with the Master Sword to stun him.

evidence.quote: What he does is float around and fire this energy blast at you. The energy blast can be deflected with the Master Sword back at him for damage.

subject: Flare Dancer
text: Targeting the Flare Dancer with the Hookshot pulls its core out of the flames so it can be attacked.

evidence.quote: Make sure you have the Hookshot equipped and target the Flare Dancing using the L/Z button. Hit the Hookshot button and you should be able to pull the actual, hit-able section of the boss out.

subject: Flare Dancer
text: The Flare Dancer is defeated after its core is caught and damaged about three or four times.

evidence.quote: four times and the miniboss will quickly fall victim to your blade.

subject: Volvagia
text: Volvagia emerges randomly from one of nine holes and can be stunned and damaged using only the Megaton Hammer.

evidence.quote: Forget absolutely every weapon and item for this battle with the one exception being the Megaton Hammer, it's your only weapon. There are nine holes in the field here and the boss will randomly pop out of one of them... After that you have a window to run up and slam him with the Megaton Hammer. Doing so will make him swing his flaming hair one more time and then drop, allowing you to go in with the hammer for a second hit.

subject: Volvagia
text: Volvagia is defeated after about five or six successful hammer attack cycles.

evidence.quote: About five or six successful runs for the win.

subject: Shadow Link
text: Shadow Link mimics Link's attacks and deflects strikes easily if targeted with L/Z, so fighting without L/Z targeting prevents him from lining up deflections.

evidence.quote: First of all Shadow Link will mimic every attack that you do, so if you target him with L/Z and then keep using the overhead swing, you'll clash swords until the end of time. What you really want to do is avoid using L/Z targeting, that way he won't be able to line up his deflection swings as easily.

subject: Shadow Link
text: Using a stab attack against Shadow Link causes him to jump onto the sword and strike back every time.

evidence.quote: is to avoid using the stab, he'll jump on your sword and hit you every time.

subject: Morpha
text: Morpha's tentacles deal about one heart of damage on contact and upwards of three hearts if Link is grabbed.

evidence.quote: If one of them lands on you, you take about one heart worth of damage, but if one of them grabs hold of you, it can deal upwards of three hearts, this attack is very powerful!

subject: Morpha
text: Firing the Longshot at Morpha as it moves through a tentacle pulls the amoeba core out of the water where it can be attacked with sword slashes or Spin Attacks.

evidence.quote: Take aim near the end of the tentacle with your Longshot and fire at Morpha to suck it out of the water and leave it open to attack... After getting it out of the water you can attack with your sword. I recommend using the Spin Attack, the one where you press B after spinning the analog stick.

subject: Deadhand
text: Deadhand is lured out when Link is grabbed by one of the hands in the room, exposing its head to a Jump Attack when it lowers down.

evidence.quote: There are four hand things coming up in the corners or this room, when you get close to the hands they grab at you and hold you in place... It also has another side effect, it makes the boss appear... When he lowers his head down press the A button to do a Jump Attack for a good damage.
